# Kenney Car Kit 1.4 — CC0

Author: Kenney, https://kenney.nl/assets/car-kit
Downloaded source mirror: https://github.com/ETdoFresh/kenney.nl/tree/master/carkit_v1.4
Retrieved 2026-10-22. This is the mirror's version 1.4, not a claim to contain the
current official site's newer release.

Original `License.txt` and source PNGs are preserved. The two `*-trim.png` sprites
are alpha-trimmed/resized to 144px width with sharp via `npm run art:furniture`.
Used as stationary production/visitor parking props outside the playable campus
grid. They are scenery, not purchasable/drivable vehicles or simulated arrivals.
